name: Rhys Evans
bio:
Rhys grew up around motorsport, with his father being a mechanic for a local rally team. He always had a keen eye for detail and a steady hand, which led him naturally towards paintwork. He started by helping his dad prep the cars, eventually moving onto small touch-ups and repairs. Seeing the cars transformed after a fresh coat of paint ignited his passion.

He's now eager to hone his skills and learn from experienced professionals. Rhys understands the importance of meticulous preparation and precise application. He's not afraid to experiment with new techniques but always prioritizes quality and durability. His team-player attitude and willingness to learn make him a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

 Rhys's passion stems from his desire to see cars looking their best, even under the harsh conditions of racing. He believes a good paint job isn't just about aesthetics; it's about pride and attention to detail, reflecting the dedication of the entire team.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a wiry build, and a focused look.

quirks: Always listens to classic rock while working.
Meticulously cleans his spray gun after every use, regardless of how small the job was.
Has a lucky paintbrush he refuses to replace.
